title: From now on, not only will you be able to find documents on the Search Portal , but also selected information about ETH Library and its services.
main_content:
From now on, not only will you be able to find documents on the Search Portal , but also selected information about ETH Library and its services.

Type a term such as “opening times”, “open access” or “geosciences” in the search field. Links to ETH Library’s websites along with the corresponding information will then appear.
